gh pr create --base main --head fix/7-refresh-recursion --title "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() on expired session" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` called itself with the same expired session, so it never returned and the page froze.

## Change
- `refresh(session, fetchSession)` now returns `fetchSession()` when the session is expired, instead of recursing.
- `fetchSession` is a new parameter, supplied by the caller.

## Open point
`fetchSession` is not defined anywhere in this repo (the repo currently has only `src/auth.js`). I did not invent an implementation, so callers must pass one in. If it is meant to live in this module, it needs to be added in a follow-up.

## Verification
Ran `refresh` under node: a non-expired session is returned unchanged; an expired session yields the value from the supplied `fetchSession`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1
